content: The product is available in 9-gram canisters containing 60 metered inhalations, packaged in institutional pack boxes of 1 (NDC 0173-0497-00), and in 13-gram canisters containing 120 metered inhalations, packaged in boxes of 1 (NDC 0173-0491-00). Each canister is equipped with a dark orange oral actuator, a peach strap cap, and includes patient instructions. Each actuation of the inhaler delivers 44 micrograms of fluticasone propionate from the actuator. Additionally, the product is available in 9-gram canisters containing 60 metered inhalations, packaged in institutional pack boxes of 1 (NDC 0173-0498-00), and in 13-gram canisters containing 120 metered inhalations, packaged in boxes of 1 (NDC 0173-0494-00). Each canister is supplied with a dark orange oral actuator, a peach strap cap, and patient instructions. Each actuation of the inhaler delivers 110 micrograms of fluticasone propionate from the actuator. Furthermore, the product is also available in 9-gram canisters containing 60 metered inhalations, packaged in institutional pack boxes of 1 (NDC 0173-0499-00), and in 13-gram canisters containing 120 metered inhalations, packaged in boxes of 1 (NDC 0173-0495-00). Each canister is provided with a dark orange oral actuator, a peach strap cap, and patient instructions. Each actuation of the inhaler delivers 220 micrograms of fluticasone propionate from the actuator. The canister should be discarded once the labeled number of actuations has been used, even if the canister is not completely empty. For example, discard the 9-gram canister after 60 inhalations or the 13-gram canister after 120 inhalations. Storage instructions specify that the product should be stored between 2°C and 30°C (36°F and 86°F). The canister should be stored with the mouthpiece facing downward. It must be protected from freezing temperatures and direct sunlight. This information has been adapted from the FDA Package Insert.
